source: Fitted 2026-09-26 to the Balmer, Mg b and Na D line depths of Schedar, Mirach and Mirfak (frames of 2026-09-25, Star Analyzer 200 on the Apertura 75Q): the Gaussian blur that makes each catalog-type reference match the observed dip depth, straight line 119 A + 27 A per 1000 A about 5500 A. Vega, Albireo B, Deneb and Albireo A were held out. Below 4400 A the widths are the trail widths (Vega Hgamma at 4340 A needed 41 A, the trail says 36-45 A); above 6563 A the value is held at the 6563 A one because nothing was measured beyond it. Focuser temperature 18-22 C across the stars, one setup only.
